overview: John Petrella interviewed attorney Nick Giurleo regarding the six design options for the Medford High School project and recent zoning amendments in Medford Square. The meeting also introduced the Neighborhood Ambassador Program, which Giurleo recently joined to represent West Medford.

items.title: Medford High School Project Design Options
items.summary: Giurleo summarized six design options currently in the feasibility phase, ranging from a $437 million code upgrade to an $893 million new construction proposal. Recent modifications to several designs aim to eliminate the need for modular classroom units during the construction process.

items.title: Medford Square Zoning and Transom Project
items.summary: The City Council approved a new Medford Square Zoning District and a specific overlay district to facilitate the Transom housing project, which includes 283 apartments and a grocery store. The new zoning allows neighborhood medical offices as of right but requires special permits for banks and prohibits funeral homes in the district.

items.title: Neighborhood Ambassador Program
items.summary: Giurleo discussed his appointment as the West Medford representative in a new program designed to bridge communication between residents and city administration. The group held its first meeting and plans to publish minutes to ensure transparency for the public.

subject: High School Designs and Neighborhood Ambassador Program
